content: Platega.io payments for Telegram VPN bots: methods SBP QR (2), RU cards (10), acquiring (11/12), crypto (13); transaction create returns redirect URL; status callback POST with X-MerchantId/X-Secret header verification, statuses CONFIRMED/CANCELED/CHARGEBACKED, HTTPS-only endpoint returning 200 else 3 retries; recurrent SBP subscriptions supported with SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED callbacks. Real bot (Nemo VPN) uses Platega for MIR/SBP plus CryptoBot, payload binds payment to telegram_id.
